WITH RECURSIVE call_chain AS (
  SELECT caller_symbol_id, callee_symbol_id
  FROM code.calls
  WHERE callee_symbol_id = 'Client._send_single_request'
    AND caller_symbol_id != 'Client._send_single_request'
    AND resolution = 'internal'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, cc.callee_symbol_id
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN call_chain cc ON c.callee_symbol_id = cc.caller_symbol_id
  WHERE c.callee_symbol_id != 'Client._send_single_request'
    AND c.resolution = 'internal'
)
SELECT DISTINCT caller_symbol_id
FROM call_chain
ORDER BY caller_symbol_id;
